chemistry_incorporation.stage: Gas-Phase Radical & Anion Chemistry (Stage 1A)
chemistry_incorporation.reaction: C₂H₂ + e⁻ → C₂H• + H•   |   C₂H⁻ + n C₂H₂ → C₂ₙH⁻ (dust)
chemistry_incorporation.mechanism: Electron-impact dissociation generates ethynyl (`C₂H•`, bare sticking `beta_0 ~ 0.08`) while acetylene anion chain polymerization forms negatively charged nanoparticles trapped in the plasma potential if residence time `tau_res` is too long.
chemistry_incorporation.model_coupling: Computes `gamma_c2hx`, `dust_margin`, and OES `C₂/CH` directly from `(freq, power, P, gap, Ar, C₂H₂)`.

chemistry_incorporation.stage: Surface Site Passivation & Volatile HCN Scavenging (Stage 1A -> Stage 2)
chemistry_incorporation.reaction: NH₃ + e⁻ → NHₓ• + H•   |   NHₓ• + C₂Hₓ(ads) → HCN(g)↑ + -C-H / -C-NH₂(surf)
chemistry_incorporation.mechanism: Ammonia radicals abstract reactive carbon oligomers into volatile `HCN` gas (tracked live via OES `CN/Ar`) and passivate sidewall dangling bonds with `-H` and `-NH₂`, slashing effective sticking `beta_eff` from `0.032` down to `0.006`.
chemistry_incorporation.model_coupling: Governs depth-dependent passivation coverage `theta_pass(z)` and calibratable kinetic constant `k_pass`.

chemistry_incorporation.stage: Bulk Amorphous Network Crosslinking & Hardmask Density (Stage 1B + 3D Molecular Sim)
chemistry_incorporation.reaction: sp² C=C + -NH₂ --(ΔT >= 560 °C, E_i)--> C=N-C bridge + H₂(g)↑
chemistry_incorporation.mechanism: At low temperature (`< 545 °C`) and excess `NH₃`, terminal `-NH₂` groups break up the carbon network (`rho < 1.78 g/cm³`). Thermal activation (`>= 560 °C`) drives de-amination into dense `sp²/sp³/C=N` crosslinks (`rho >= 1.82 g/cm³`) needed for TSMC etch selectivity.
chemistry_incorporation.model_coupling: 16-anchor DFT/XPS neural surrogate + callable RDKit `MMFF94s` / `LAMMPS ReaxFF` 3D nanocluster relaxation.

physics_incorporation.stage: Capacitive RF Sheath Electrodynamics & Fluidic Gap Physics (Stage 1A)
physics_incorporation.equation: n_e ∝ ω² P_rf ,   V_sh ∝ P_rf / (ω^α n_e) ,   ΔP_Poiseuille = 3 μ Q / (π d³)
physics_incorporation.mechanism: Switching from `13.56 MHz` to `27.12 MHz` doubles plasma frequency `ω`, raising radical dissociation while dropping ion sheath energy `E_i` from `~28 eV` to `~11 eV` so ions stop activating high-sticking dangling bonds at the feature entrance.
physics_incorporation.model_coupling: Feeds ion energy `E_i`, sheath thickness `2s_m/d`, and Poiseuille radial uniformity check.

physics_incorporation.stage: Ballistic Knudsen Transport & View-Factor Shadowing (Stage 2)
physics_incorporation.equation: Kn = λ_mfp / CD ≈ 70–130 ≫ 1 ,   Γ_C(z)/Γ_C(0) = cosh(Φ(1 - z/L)) / cosh(Φ)
physics_incorporation.mechanism: Inside a `110 nm` hole at `18 Torr`, gas molecules never collide with each other — only with sidewalls. Directional ions hit the top field (`F_view = 1.0`) while isotropic passivated neutrals bounce >100× to the bottom (`z = 1000 nm`), enabling bottom-up superconformal fill (`v_floor > v_mouth`).
physics_incorporation.model_coupling: 1D ballistic reaction-transport profile solver calibrated end-to-end via Bayesian MAP (`theta^`) on real SEM wafers.

physics_incorporation.stage: Steinbrüchel Cyclic Mouth Trim & Griffith Fracture Mechanics (Stage 2 -> Stage 4)
physics_incorporation.equation: Y_trim(E_i) = b · max(0, √E_i - √E_th) ,   G = σ² h_OB (1 - ν) / E < G_c
physics_incorporation.mechanism: Cyclic `Ar/NH₃` plasma trim shaves top planar overburden `h_OB` and re-opens the `z < 120 nm` throat, simultaneously satisfying TSMC's `OB <= 85 nm` CMP cap and keeping elastic strain energy `G` far below the oxide-interface cracking threshold `G_c`.
physics_incorporation.model_coupling: Couples calibrated physics + Matérn-5/2 GP residuals (`± σ`) into Constrained Expected Improvement BO.

understanding.headline: Baseline Diagnosis (0 Wafers, 0 Pass): Single-Step PECVD Cannot Simultaneously Beat TSMC's PH >= 985 nm Fill and OB <= 85 nm Overburden Cap
key_findings: 13.56 MHz RF fails fundamentally: high capacitive sheath energy (~28 eV) creates unpassivated dangling bonds at the z < 100 nm entrance, pinching off 110 nm holes at 588–794 nm with 146–253 nm OB.

Switching to 27.12 MHz + NH₃/C₂H₂ ≈ 0.35 lowers sticking β_eff from ~0.031 to ~0.0065 (Thiele Φ₁₁₀ ≈ 0.90), lifting single-step fill to 964 nm — still 21 nm short of 985 nm while OB = 118 nm exceeds 85 nm.

Step 4A multi-scale simulations show the unlock: adding 18–24% cyclic Ar/NH₃ mouth trim (DED) selectively shaves the top collar and planar OB down to 60–70 nm while keeping the throat open until z = 1000 nm fills seamlessly.
understanding.ai_strategy: Selected Strategy: Physics-Informed Constrained Expected Improvement (cEI) restricted to dust-free Ar >= 10.5 slm, probing 27.12 MHz + cyclic Ar/NH₃ trim [12%–24%] + NH₃/C₂H₂ [0.34–0.40] against one 13.56 MHz trimmed control.

0.banner_title: Why This Platform Exists: Compressing 6 Weeks of Cross-Team Handoffs into 1 Self-Service Loop
0.what_happens: In semiconductor equipment development today, qualifying a new High-Aspect-Ratio (HAR) PECVD process for a leading foundry requires constant handoffs between four separate roles: a PECVD Process Engineer, a Plasma/TCAD Simulation Engineer, a Metrology/SEM Analyst, and an ML/Data Scientist. Each handoff adds days of ticket queues, spreadsheet transcription, and lost physical context. This platform unifies all four layers into a single 4-Layer Decision Pyramid that one Process Technologist can drive end-to-end.
0.how_to_use: Hover or click any '?' badge to read plain-English definitions of plasma, chemistry, and AI terms. Review the 4-Layer Pyramid and 6-Sprint Productization Plan below, then click 'Start TSMC Qualification Demo (Step 1) →' to walk through a realistic customer qualification.

deep_dives.q: Do we still need Simulation Engineers and ML Engineers with this system?
deep_dives.a: Not inside the daily wafer-to-wafer customer qualification loop! Routine multi-scale simulations, kinetic calibration, uncertainty quantification, and next-batch Bayesian Optimization run self-service in seconds. Simulation Engineers shift to authoring new chamber geometries and reactive force fields in Layer 3, while ML Engineers maintain fleet-wide foundation surrogates.

deep_dives.q: Is the underlying model real math/physics or hard-coded demo slides?
deep_dives.a: It is a real 4-stage Physics-Augmented Neural-Gaussian (PANG) engine: Stage 1 neural surrogates trained on peer-reviewed CCP and DFT/XPS bonding benchmarks; Stage 2 non-linear least-squares Bayesian MAP calibration of 6 physical surface-kinetic constants (θ̂); Stage 3 Matérn-5/2 Gaussian Processes learning residual discrepancies with honest ±σ uncertainty; and Stage 4 AST-compiled causal rules driving Constrained Expected Improvement (cEI) optimization.

deep_dives.q: How does data safety work between Demo Mode and Live Cleanroom Mode?
deep_dives.a: Every guided walkthrough, synthetic campaign, and virtual wafer runs inside an isolated sandbox state (Rule s1) so live measured cleanroom wafer records are never mutated. On this GitHub Pages build, a trained neural + analytical surrogate mirrors the full Python Brain directly in your browser.

1.banner_title: Step 1 Guide: Translating a Foundry Customer Spec (TSMC N2) into Machine-Checkable Acceptance Gates
1.what_happens: Every process development campaign starts with a customer's integration spec sheet — not an abstract ML loss function. In 2 nm / A16 Backside Power and 3D FinFET/GAA patterning, spin-on carbon (SOC) outgasses and shrinks during >= 400 °C anneals, so fabs demand high-temperature PECVD amorphous carbon (a-C:H:N) that fills both tight 110 nm vias (AR 9.1) and wide 225 nm trenches (AR 4.4) 1,000 nm deep with zero trapped seams, minimal top overburden (<= 85 nm) for single-step CMP, and high density (>= 1.80 g/cm³) for etch resistance.
1.how_to_use: Compare the two TSMC program presets below (or open 'Customize Spec Numbers Manually' to edit any threshold), inspect the 6 acceptance gates, and click 'Lock TSMC Spec & Continue to Step 2 →'.

deep_dives.q: Why are PH >= 985 nm and OB <= 85 nm in direct physical conflict?
deep_dives.a: Running deposition longer pushes more carbon into the trench to increase penetration depth (PH), but also piles thick blanket carbon onto the top planar field (Overburden, OB). Worse, if sticking probability β_eff is too high, the top mouth pinches shut early — so depositing longer ONLY grows top overburden while the buried keyhole void stays frozen inside!

deep_dives.q: Why does TSMC require XRR Film Density >= 1.80 g/cm³ and Zero Nodules?
deep_dives.a: After gap-fill and CMP planarization, the carbon plug acts as a hardmask during aggressive CF₄/O₂ plasma etching of underlying oxide/nitride. Low-density polymer-like carbon (< 1.78 g/cm³) etches away prematurely and loses critical dimension (CD), while even a single C₂ₙH⁻ dust nodule blocks etch locally and causes a killer bridge defect across metal lines.

2.banner_title: Step 2 Guide: Loading Screening Wafers & Diagnosing Why Every Baseline Recipe Fails (0/8 Pass)
2.what_happens: When a qualification starts, the team usually has an initial screening lot from legacy 13.56 MHz or exploratory 27.12 MHz single-step recipes. Instead of manually coloring Excel cells, Layer 1 ingests the screening lot (or your uploaded .csv/.json file), preserves nulls for unmeasured sensors, and grades every wafer line-by-line against Step 1's TSMC spec — immediately revealing three distinct physical failure walls.
2.how_to_use: Click 'Load 8-Wafer Preloaded Dataset' on the Recommended AMAT Producer Baseline Lot (or test the 6-wafer Dust Stress Lot / upload a CSV), then scan the red FAIL badges in the table to see why single-step tweaks hit a dead end.

deep_dives.q: What are the 3 failure walls revealed in the 8-wafer baseline lot?
deep_dives.a: (1) Legacy 13.56 MHz coupons (BL-01..04) suffer high sheath ion bombardment (~28 eV) that activates top-corner dangling bonds, pinching off 110 nm vias at 588–794 nm with 146–253 nm OB and corner cracks. (2) High pressure + low Ar (BL-02) triggers gas-phase C₂ₙH⁻ dust nodules. (3) Single-step 27.12 MHz (BL-06..08) reaches 964 nm fill at 118 nm OB, but cutting time (BL-07) starves fill to 815 nm, and adding excess NH₃ at 535 °C (BL-08) drops density to 1.74 g/cm³.

3.banner_title: Step 3 Guide: Versioned Knowledge Governance, IP Separation & Physics/Chemistry Priors
3.what_happens: Pure black-box ML needs hundreds of wafers because it starts ignorant of plasma sheaths, ballistic Knudsen transport, and chamber hardware limits. Layer 2 injects structured scientific and engineering priors into the Brain while enforcing strict IP governance across three tiers: (1) Public Peer-Reviewed Science (102 papers + 10 benchmark tables), (2) Proprietary AMAT Producer Chamber BKMs (AST-compiled rules PROP-AMAT-01..05), and (3) Customer Lot Metrology.
3.how_to_use: Try switching between KB v1.0 (Public Only), KB v2.0 (+ Chamber Hardware Guards), and KB v2.1 (Recommended Full Hybrid) to see how active rules change. Review the Chemistry & Physics incorporation cards and try the Configuration Paper Search below before continuing to Step 4A.

deep_dives.q: What actually changes inside the math when I switch KB v1.0 → KB v2.0 → KB v2.1?
deep_dives.a: KB v1.0 provides the Stage-1 CCP & DFT Bonding neural priors plus ballistic Knudsen physics, but leaves high-pressure dust and cyclic trim unguided. KB v2.0 activates proprietary hardware hazard penalties (PROP-AMAT-01..03) that zero out acquisition weight in dusty/arcing zones. KB v2.1 adds positive prior shifts and selectivity guidance for 27.12 MHz VHF + NH₃ passivation (PROP-AMAT-04) and cyclic Ar/NH₃ mouth trim (PROP-AMAT-05), cutting search waste by >60%.

deep_dives.q: How do Chemistry and Physics couple mathematically across Stages 1–4?
deep_dives.a: Gas-phase CCP physics sets electron density n_e and sheath ion energy E_i; gas/surface chemistry converts NH₃ + C₂H₂ radical ratios into volatile HCN scavenging and surface passivation coverage θ_pass(z), determining effective sticking β_eff; Knudsen ballistic transport maps β_eff into depth-resolved growth v_net(z) via Thiele modulus Φ; and Steinbrüchel ion-etch yield models cyclic Ar/NH₃ mouth shaving of top overburden.

4A.banner_title: Step 4A Guide: AI Gap Triage & Calling Coupled Multi-Scale Simulations In-Platform
4A.what_happens: Inspecting Step 2's data + Step 3's KB, the AI spots a critical blind spot: all 8 baseline wafers were single-step depositions (0% cyclic trim), so a purely data-driven model would have huge uncertainty in cyclic Dep–Etch–Dep (DED) space! Layer 3 bridges that gap before cutting cleanroom wafers by running coupled 3-scale simulations: Chamber CCP Plasma → 1D Ballistic Knudsen Feature Profile → 3D Atomistic a-C:H:N Network Relaxation.
4A.how_to_use: Click '⚡ Load Prebuilt 6-Run Multi-Scale Simulation Pack' to assimilate 6 benchmark simulations covering 13.56 vs. 27.12 MHz, 12%–24% cyclic trim, and high-NH₃ density dilution — then try tweaking the knobs on the right and clicking '▶ Run Live Multi-Scale Simulation' to execute a new coupled run on the spot!

deep_dives.q: How do the 3 simulation scales pass boundary conditions to each other?
deep_dives.a: (1) The CCP reactor model takes chamber knobs (RF, Power, Gap, P, Ar, C₂H₂, NH₃, T) and outputs ion energy E_i (eV), radical flux ratio Γ_(H+NHx)/Γ_C2Hx, and Knudsen number Kn. (2) The Feature-scale Knudsen solver uses those exact fluxes + cyclic trim fraction to integrate sidewall and bottom film evolution (PH₁₁₀, OB, keyhole void width). (3) The 3D Molecular engine (RDKit ETKDGv3 + MMFF94s, plus exportable LAMMPS ReaxFF C/H/N decks) relaxes a stoichiometric a-C:H:N cluster to predict sp²/sp³ fractions and bulk density ρ.

4B.banner_title: Step 4B Guide: Plain-English Process Synthesis & How to Read the Two Mechanism Figures
4B.what_happens: Before approving cleanroom wafers, a Principal PECVD Technologist and customer integration lead need an interpretable physical picture — not just a table of numbers. Step 4B synthesizes the calibrated kinetic parameters (θ̂), wafer residuals, and simulation pack into a clear mechanistic diagnosis plus two publication-grade visual figures.
4B.how_to_use: Read the 3 quantitative takeaways at top, then compare Panels A, B, and C in Figure 1 (left) and inspect where the red × baseline wafers, blue ◇ simulations, and green target box sit in Figure 2 (right).

deep_dives.q: How do I read Figure 1 (the 3 HAR Via Cross-Sections)?
deep_dives.a: Each column shows a 110 nm wide × 1000 nm deep SiO₂ via to scale, with the dashed amber line marking TSMC's 85 nm max planar overburden cap. In Panel A (13.56 MHz), high-energy ions create sticky upper sidewalls that bridge early and trap a large red keyhole void with 182 nm OB. In Panel B (27.12 MHz + NH₃, 0% trim), radicals bounce deep (964 nm) leaving a tiny 7.5 nm seam, but top OB (118 nm) still breaches the 85 nm line. In Panel C (+22% cyclic Ar/NH₃ trim), grazing-angle trim arrows shave the top collar and planar OB down to 63.8 nm while bottom-up growth fills 100% void-free.

deep_dives.q: How do I read Figure 2 (the 2D Operating Regime Map)?
deep_dives.a: The horizontal axis is NH₃/C₂H₂ flow ratio (controlling surface passivation vs. nitrogen incorporation) and the vertical axis is Cyclic Trim % (controlling top-mouth shaving). Left of N/C = 0.30 (pink) sticking is too high -> keyhole pinch-off. Below Trim = 14% (amber) planar overburden exceeds 85 nm. Right of N/C = 0.385 at low temperature (purple) excess -NH₂ softens density below 1.80 g/cm³. Notice all 8 baseline red × wafers sit along the bottom 0%-trim edge — completely outside the green TSMC Target Window!

5.banner_title: Step 5 Guide: Active Bayesian Optimization — Proposing the Fewest Wafers to Hit Spec
5.what_happens: Patterned 300 mm HAR test wafers and cross-section FIB-SEM slots are expensive (~$2,500–$4,000 per wafer including metrology and chamber time). Instead of a 27-wafer full-factorial DoE grid, Layer 3 evaluates thousands of candidate multi-step recipes using Constrained Expected Improvement (cEI) and selects a diverse 3-wafer cassette split with immutable UUID prediction logs.
5.how_to_use: Click '🎯 Run Bayesian Optimization' to generate the 3-wafer run-sheet. Inspect each wafer's assigned DoE role, predicted PH₁₁₀ ± σ, OB ± σ, density ρ, and P(Meets TSMC Spec), optionally export the .csv run-sheet for the chamber, then continue to Step 6.

deep_dives.q: Why does Bayesian Optimization propose 3 different roles instead of 3 nearly identical recipes?
deep_dives.a: Batch diversity (penalizing kernel correlation across the 3 slots) prevents wasting 3 wafers on the same unknown bias: Wafer #1 (Exploitation Anchor) targets the highest joint probability of passing TSMC's spec right now; Wafer #2 (High-Trim Low-OB Probe) pushes deeper into 24% cyclic trim to map the overburden floor; and Wafer #3 (Control / Boundary Guard) anchors RF sheath or thermal crosslinking sensitivity so the GP uncertainty collapses rapidly.

6.banner_title: Step 6 Guide: Cleanroom Metrology Return, Line-by-Line Grading & Prediction Audit
6.what_happens: After running the 3 proposed wafers in the Producer PECVD chamber and measuring cross-section CD-SEM, XRR density, inline OES, and AFM roughness, the results flow back into Layer 1. Every wafer is automatically graded against all 6 TSMC acceptance criteria, linked back to its pre-run UUID prediction to audit model accuracy, and assimilated to update θ̂ and GP posteriors.
6.how_to_use: Click '📥 Load & Auto-Grade Cleanroom Results (3 Wafers)' (or open the manual entry drawer to test your own numbers) and examine which spec lines turned green PASS vs. red FAIL.

deep_dives.q: Why doesn't Round 1 pass 100% immediately — and why is Round 1's 'near-miss' actually a huge win?
deep_dives.a: In real cleanroom development, jumping into a brand-new cyclic trim regime (0% -> 24% trim) often uncovers a secondary material trade-off! Round 1 solves the hardest geometric barriers immediately — TSMC-R1-W1 hits seamless 991.2 nm fill & 1.83 g/cm³ density (missing OB <= 85 nm by just 9.2 nm), while TSMC-R1-W2 hits 65.8 nm OB & 993.8 nm fill (missing ρ >= 1.80 g/cm³ by just 0.03 g/cm³ because high NH₃ at 544 °C left un-crosslinked -NH₂ groups). Bracketing both sides in 3 wafers gives the exact physical key needed to close qualification in Round 2!

7.banner_title: Step 7 Guide: Turning Round-1 Cleanroom Surprises into Versioned Institutional Knowledge (KB v2.2)
7.what_happens: When Round 1's TSMC-R1-W2 wafer comes back at ρ = 1.77 g/cm³ (< 1.80 spec), a conventional black-box optimizer only sees a scalar penalty on one data point. Here, the platform diagnoses the physical residual — aggressive NH₃ trim (>=18%) + high N/C (>0.38) below 555 °C retains terminal -NH₂ groups — and proposes an explicit, human-readable AST causal rule (PROP-TSMC-06) that upgrades your Knowledge Base from KB v2.1 to KB v2.2.
7.how_to_use: Read the Residual & Mechanism Diagnosis and the candidate AST rule expression, click '✓ Promote Rule PROP-TSMC-06 into Knowledge Base (Upgrade → KB v2.2)', then proceed to Step 8.

deep_dives.q: Why promote an explicit KB rule instead of relying purely on the Gaussian Process residual?
deep_dives.a: Two reasons: (1) Immediate global generalization — the rule steers Round 2 directly into T >= 560 °C + N/C ∈ [0.33, 0.37] across the entire recipe space instead of only within one local GP length-scale; and (2) Reusable institutional memory — when the next customer asks for a 95 nm HAR plug six months later, KB v2.2 already carries this verified Trim × Temperature crosslinking law!

8.banner_title: Step 8 Guide: Closing the Loop to 100% Spec Compliance & Cleanroom Recipe Sign-Off
8.what_happens: With KB v2.2 active and Round-1 metrology assimilated, repeating Steps 4–6 for Round 2 co-optimizes 27.12 MHz VHF plasma, N/C = 0.352 passivation, 22% cyclic Ar/NH₃ mouth trim, and 566 °C thermal de-amination. All 3 Round-2 wafers pass 100% of TSMC's criteria simultaneously — led by qualified winner TSMC-R2-W1 (PH₁₁₀ = 996.4 nm, PH₂₂₅ = 998.2 nm, OB = 63.8 nm, ρ = 1.84 g/cm³, AFM R_q = 1.18 nm, zero cracks/nodules).
8.how_to_use: If Round 2 hasn't run yet, click '⚡ Run Round 2 Loop (Steps 4–6) to Convergence Now' (or step through Round 2 manually). Once qualified, inspect the green TSMC Qualification Certificate, Trajectory Chart, export the .json sign-off package, or click '⚙ Inspect in 6-Tab Workbench' for deep diagnostics.

deep_dives.q: What is the bottom-line cleanroom ROI demonstrated by this 8-step campaign?
deep_dives.a: Qualification converged in just 2 active DoE rounds (6 optimization wafers + 8 baseline coupons = 14 patterned wafers total), compared with 8–10 manual trial-and-error rounds (45–60 wafers and 5–6 weeks of cross-team iteration) typical of dual-CD HAR gap-fill development — while leaving behind a versioned Knowledge Base (KB v2.2) and full UUID prediction-to-metrology audit trail.

har.definition: Feature depth divided by critical opening width (AR = Depth / CD). At AR >= 8:1 (e.g., 1000 nm deep / 110 nm wide = 9.1:1), reactive radicals collide dozens of times with upper sidewalls before reaching the floor.

ph_depth.definition: Depth from the top mold opening down to the shallowest void or seam inside the 110 nm tight feature or 225 nm wide feature. Seamless bottom-up plug fill requires PH >= 985 nm in a 1000 nm deep feature.

overburden.definition: Unwanted blanket carbon thickness deposited on top of the flat field between features. TSMC caps OB <= 85 nm so downstream CMP or plasma etch-back stays single-step without dishing.

keyhole_void.definition: A hollow teardrop cavity trapped inside the trench/via when upper sidewalls grow faster than the bottom and seal the throat early. Trapped voids outgas and burst during 400 °C anneal or plasma etch.

ccp.definition: Parallel-plate PECVD reactor architecture (e.g., Applied Materials Producer) where RF power across a heated showerhead-to-pedestal gap (400–500 mils) sustains the plasma.

vhf_27mhz.definition: Doubling RF frequency from 13.56 to 27.12 MHz increases electron density (n_e ~ f^2) for efficient NH₃/C₂H₂ dissociation while cutting capacitive sheath voltage V_sh and ion energy E_i (~29 eV -> ~11 eV), preventing top-corner overhang.

knudsen.definition: Ratio of gas mean free path (lambda ~ 8–14 um at 18 Torr) to feature width (CD = 110 nm). Because Kn ~ 70–130 >> 1, gas transport inside the feature is purely ballistic free-molecular bounce, not continuum fluid flow.

thiele.definition: Dimensionless competition between sidewall reaction loss and ballistic transport down the hole: Φ = AR * sqrt(1.5 * beta_eff). Seamless fill requires Φ < 0.85, which means lowering sticking probability beta_eff below ~0.008.

beta_eff.definition: Probability that a carbon growth radical sticks on a single wall collision. Unpassivated C₂H• has high β ~ 0.08 (sticks near the mouth); -H and -NH₂ surface passivation lowers β_eff below 0.007 so radicals bounce >100 times to the bottom.

hcn_scavenging.definition: Adding NH₃ supplies H• and NHₓ• radicals that cap surface dangling bonds with -H/-NH₂ and convert reactive C₂Hₓ oligomers into volatile HCN gas that pumps away harmlessly.

dust_nodule.definition: At high pressure (>20 Torr) and long gas residence time (low Ar dilution), C₂H⁻ anions polymerize in the plasma bulk into carbon nanoparticles that fall onto the wafer as killer nodule defects.

ded_trim.definition: Deposition–Etch–Deposition cycle where brief directional Ar⁺/NHₓ⁺ ion-assisted chemical etch selectively shaves the z < 120 nm top entrance collar and planar overburden without etching the shielded feature floor.

griffith_crack.definition: Elastic strain energy release rate G = sigma^2 * h_OB * (1 - nu) / E. When compressive stress sigma and planar overburden h_OB are both high (OB > 155 nm), G exceeds interfacial toughness G_c and the carbon film cracks.

film_density.definition: Bulk mass density measured by X-Ray Reflectivity. TSMC requires ρ >= 1.80 g/cm³ to guarantee pattern-transfer hardmask etch resistance in downstream CF₄/O₂ plasma.

afm_rq.definition: Root-mean-square top-surface height variation measured by inline Atomic Force Microscopy. Smooth sp²/sp³ carbon (R_q <= 1.6 nm) avoids lithography focus errors and post-CMP micro-scratches.

map_theta.definition: Maximum A Posteriori estimation of the 6 physical surface-kinetic constants (β_c0, k_pass, γ_rec, y_iece, ob_scale, crack_thresh) anchored to literature priors and updated every time cleanroom wafers arrive.

gp_discrepancy.definition: Non-parametric probabilistic model trained on the residual gap between calibrated physics and real wafer measurements, providing honest epistemic uncertainty (± σ) everywhere in recipe space.

constrained_ei.definition: Acquisition score cEI(x) = EI(x) * P(Meets All Spec Lines | x) * RulePrior(x) that balances exploiting high-probability sweet spots with exploring high-uncertainty regions that could unlock lower overburden.

reaxff.definition: Atomistic relaxation of amorphous C/H/N bonding networks (sp² rings, sp³ crosslinks, -NH₂/-C≡N terminations) predicting bulk density ρ, stress, and fluorine etch barriers before running wafers.

oes_actinometry.definition: Optical Emission Spectroscopy ratio dividing CN* radical emission (388.3 nm) by inert Ar* emission (750.4 nm) to track real-time HCN scavenging and nitrogen passivation inside the chamber without breaking vacuum.

rf_3w.definition: Ratio of 3rd-harmonic RF current to fundamental RF current at the matchbox. Non-linear sheath capacitance and trapped C₂ₙH⁻ dust clouds spike 3ω/1ω above 9.5%, providing an early warning before particle defects land.

dual_cd.definition: Real logic and memory dies place narrow vias (110 nm, AR 9.1) right next to wide trenches (225 nm, AR 4.4). A valid recipe must fill both simultaneously without voids in the narrow via or under-fill in the wide trench.

residence_time.definition: Average time gas molecules spend inside the active RF gap (τ_res ~ P * V_gap / Q_total). If τ_res exceeds ~42 ms in C₂H₂ plasma, negative C₂H⁻ ions have time to polymerize into killer dust nodules.

sp2_sp3.definition: Amorphous carbon hardmasks balance aromatic sp² rings (thermal stability), tetrahedral sp³ C-C crosslinks (mechanical stiffness & density), and C=N bridges. Terminal -NH₂/-CH₃ groups lower stress but dilute density if excessive.

etch_selectivity.definition: Carbon gap-fill plugs serve as sacrificial pattern-transfer masks during aggressive fluorocarbon oxide/nitride RIE. Dense carbon (ρ >= 1.80 g/cm³) raises the fluorine activation barrier so the mask erodes slowly.

loocv.definition: Honest small-data accuracy test: holds out 1 wafer at a time, re-runs both Bayesian MAP θ̂ calibration and GP fitting from scratch on the remaining N-1 wafers, and measures blind prediction error on the held-out wafer.

sandbox_s1.definition: Strict cleanroom data boundary: demo trials, virtual wafers, and synthetic DoE campaigns execute in an isolated sandbox brain so real measured customer wafer ledgers can never be overwritten or polluted.

chemistry_incorporation.stage: Gas-Phase Radical & Anion Chemistry (Stage 1A)
chemistry_incorporation.reaction: C₂H₂ + e⁻ → C₂H• + H•   |   C₂H⁻ + n C₂H₂ → C₂ₙH⁻ (dust)
chemistry_incorporation.mechanism: Electron-impact dissociation generates ethynyl (`C₂H•`, bare sticking `beta_0 ~ 0.08`) while acetylene anion chain polymerization forms negatively charged nanoparticles trapped in the plasma potential if residence time `tau_res` is too long.
chemistry_incorporation.model_coupling: Computes `gamma_c2hx`, `dust_margin`, and OES `C₂/CH` directly from `(freq, power, P, gap, Ar, C₂H₂)`.

chemistry_incorporation.stage: Surface Site Passivation & Volatile HCN Scavenging (Stage 1A -> Stage 2)
chemistry_incorporation.reaction: NH₃ + e⁻ → NHₓ• + H•   |   NHₓ• + C₂Hₓ(ads) → HCN(g)↑ + -C-H / -C-NH₂(surf)
chemistry_incorporation.mechanism: Ammonia radicals abstract reactive carbon oligomers into volatile `HCN` gas (tracked live via OES `CN/Ar`) and passivate sidewall dangling bonds with `-H` and `-NH₂`, slashing effective sticking `beta_eff` from `0.032` down to `0.006`.
chemistry_incorporation.model_coupling: Governs depth-dependent passivation coverage `theta_pass(z)` and calibratable kinetic constant `k_pass`.

chemistry_incorporation.stage: Bulk Amorphous Network Crosslinking & Hardmask Density (Stage 1B + 3D Molecular Sim)
chemistry_incorporation.reaction: sp² C=C + -NH₂ --(ΔT >= 560 °C, E_i)--> C=N-C bridge + H₂(g)↑
chemistry_incorporation.mechanism: At low temperature (`< 545 °C`) and excess `NH₃`, terminal `-NH₂` groups break up the carbon network (`rho < 1.78 g/cm³`). Thermal activation (`>= 560 °C`) drives de-amination into dense `sp²/sp³/C=N` crosslinks (`rho >= 1.82 g/cm³`) needed for TSMC etch selectivity.
chemistry_incorporation.model_coupling: 16-anchor DFT/XPS neural surrogate + callable RDKit `MMFF94s` / `LAMMPS ReaxFF` 3D nanocluster relaxation.

physics_incorporation.stage: Capacitive RF Sheath Electrodynamics & Fluidic Gap Physics (Stage 1A)
physics_incorporation.equation: n_e ∝ ω² P_rf ,   V_sh ∝ P_rf / (ω^α n_e) ,   ΔP_Poiseuille = 3 μ Q / (π d³)
physics_incorporation.mechanism: Switching from `13.56 MHz` to `27.12 MHz` doubles plasma frequency `ω`, raising radical dissociation while dropping ion sheath energy `E_i` from `~28 eV` to `~11 eV` so ions stop activating high-sticking dangling bonds at the feature entrance.
physics_incorporation.model_coupling: Feeds ion energy `E_i`, sheath thickness `2s_m/d`, and Poiseuille radial uniformity check.

physics_incorporation.stage: Ballistic Knudsen Transport & View-Factor Shadowing (Stage 2)
physics_incorporation.equation: Kn = λ_mfp / CD ≈ 70–130 ≫ 1 ,   Γ_C(z)/Γ_C(0) = cosh(Φ(1 - z/L)) / cosh(Φ)
physics_incorporation.mechanism: Inside a `110 nm` hole at `18 Torr`, gas molecules never collide with each other — only with sidewalls. Directional ions hit the top field (`F_view = 1.0`) while isotropic passivated neutrals bounce >100× to the bottom (`z = 1000 nm`), enabling bottom-up superconformal fill (`v_floor > v_mouth`).
physics_incorporation.model_coupling: 1D ballistic reaction-transport profile solver calibrated end-to-end via Bayesian MAP (`theta^`) on real SEM wafers.

physics_incorporation.stage: Steinbrüchel Cyclic Mouth Trim & Griffith Fracture Mechanics (Stage 2 -> Stage 4)
physics_incorporation.equation: Y_trim(E_i) = b · max(0, √E_i - √E_th) ,   G = σ² h_OB (1 - ν) / E < G_c
physics_incorporation.mechanism: Cyclic `Ar/NH₃` plasma trim shaves top planar overburden `h_OB` and re-opens the `z < 120 nm` throat, simultaneously satisfying TSMC's `OB <= 85 nm` CMP cap and keeping elastic strain energy `G` far below the oxide-interface cracking threshold `G_c`.
physics_incorporation.model_coupling: Couples calibrated physics + Matérn-5/2 GP residuals (`± σ`) into Constrained Expected Improvement BO.

understanding.headline: Baseline Diagnosis (0 Wafers, 0 Pass): Single-Step PECVD Cannot Simultaneously Beat TSMC's PH >= 985 nm Fill and OB <= 85 nm Overburden Cap
key_findings: 13.56 MHz RF fails fundamentally: high capacitive sheath energy (~28 eV) creates unpassivated dangling bonds at the z < 100 nm entrance, pinching off 110 nm holes at 588–794 nm with 146–253 nm OB.

Switching to 27.12 MHz + NH₃/C₂H₂ ≈ 0.35 lowers sticking β_eff from ~0.031 to ~0.0065 (Thiele Φ₁₁₀ ≈ 0.90), lifting single-step fill to 964 nm — still 21 nm short of 985 nm while OB = 118 nm exceeds 85 nm.

Step 4A multi-scale simulations show the unlock: adding 18–24% cyclic Ar/NH₃ mouth trim (DED) selectively shaves the top collar and planar OB down to 60–70 nm while keeping the throat open until z = 1000 nm fills seamlessly.
understanding.ai_strategy: Selected Strategy: Physics-Informed Constrained Expected Improvement (cEI) restricted to dust-free Ar >= 10.5 slm, probing 27.12 MHz + cyclic Ar/NH₃ trim [12%–24%] + NH₃/C₂H₂ [0.34–0.40] against one 13.56 MHz trimmed control.

0.banner_title: Why This Platform Exists: Compressing 6 Weeks of Cross-Team Handoffs into 1 Self-Service Loop
0.what_happens: In semiconductor equipment development today, qualifying a new High-Aspect-Ratio (HAR) PECVD process for a leading foundry requires constant handoffs between four separate roles: a PECVD Process Engineer, a Plasma/TCAD Simulation Engineer, a Metrology/SEM Analyst, and an ML/Data Scientist. Each handoff adds days of ticket queues, spreadsheet transcription, and lost physical context. This platform unifies all four layers into a single 4-Layer Decision Pyramid that one Process Technologist can drive end-to-end.
0.how_to_use: Hover or click any '?' badge to read plain-English definitions of plasma, chemistry, and AI terms. Review the 4-Layer Pyramid and 6-Sprint Productization Plan below, then click 'Start TSMC Qualification Demo (Step 1) →' to walk through a realistic customer qualification.

deep_dives.q: Do we still need Simulation Engineers and ML Engineers with this system?
deep_dives.a: Not inside the daily wafer-to-wafer customer qualification loop! Routine multi-scale simulations, kinetic calibration, uncertainty quantification, and next-batch Bayesian Optimization run self-service in seconds. Simulation Engineers shift to authoring new chamber geometries and reactive force fields in Layer 3, while ML Engineers maintain fleet-wide foundation surrogates.

deep_dives.q: Is the underlying model real math/physics or hard-coded demo slides?
deep_dives.a: It is a real 4-stage Physics-Augmented Neural-Gaussian (PANG) engine: Stage 1 neural surrogates trained on peer-reviewed CCP and DFT/XPS bonding benchmarks; Stage 2 non-linear least-squares Bayesian MAP calibration of 6 physical surface-kinetic constants (θ̂); Stage 3 Matérn-5/2 Gaussian Processes learning residual discrepancies with honest ±σ uncertainty; and Stage 4 AST-compiled causal rules driving Constrained Expected Improvement (cEI) optimization.

deep_dives.q: How does data safety work between Demo Mode and Live Cleanroom Mode?
deep_dives.a: Every guided walkthrough, synthetic campaign, and virtual wafer runs inside an isolated sandbox state (Rule s1) so live measured cleanroom wafer records are never mutated. On this GitHub Pages build, a trained neural + analytical surrogate mirrors the full Python Brain directly in your browser.

1.banner_title: Step 1 Guide: Translating a Foundry Customer Spec (TSMC N2) into Machine-Checkable Acceptance Gates
1.what_happens: Every process development campaign starts with a customer's integration spec sheet — not an abstract ML loss function. In 2 nm / A16 Backside Power and 3D FinFET/GAA patterning, spin-on carbon (SOC) outgasses and shrinks during >= 400 °C anneals, so fabs demand high-temperature PECVD amorphous carbon (a-C:H:N) that fills both tight 110 nm vias (AR 9.1) and wide 225 nm trenches (AR 4.4) 1,000 nm deep with zero trapped seams, minimal top overburden (<= 85 nm) for single-step CMP, and high density (>= 1.80 g/cm³) for etch resistance.
1.how_to_use: Compare the two TSMC program presets below (or open 'Customize Spec Numbers Manually' to edit any threshold), inspect the 6 acceptance gates, and click 'Lock TSMC Spec & Continue to Step 2 →'.

deep_dives.q: Why are PH >= 985 nm and OB <= 85 nm in direct physical conflict?
deep_dives.a: Running deposition longer pushes more carbon into the trench to increase penetration depth (PH), but also piles thick blanket carbon onto the top planar field (Overburden, OB). Worse, if sticking probability β_eff is too high, the top mouth pinches shut early — so depositing longer ONLY grows top overburden while the buried keyhole void stays frozen inside!

deep_dives.q: Why does TSMC require XRR Film Density >= 1.80 g/cm³ and Zero Nodules?
deep_dives.a: After gap-fill and CMP planarization, the carbon plug acts as a hardmask during aggressive CF₄/O₂ plasma etching of underlying oxide/nitride. Low-density polymer-like carbon (< 1.78 g/cm³) etches away prematurely and loses critical dimension (CD), while even a single C₂ₙH⁻ dust nodule blocks etch locally and causes a killer bridge defect across metal lines.

2.banner_title: Step 2 Guide: Loading Screening Wafers & Diagnosing Why Every Baseline Recipe Fails (0/8 Pass)
2.what_happens: When a qualification starts, the team usually has an initial screening lot from legacy 13.56 MHz or exploratory 27.12 MHz single-step recipes. Instead of manually coloring Excel cells, Layer 1 ingests the screening lot (or your uploaded .csv/.json file), preserves nulls for unmeasured sensors, and grades every wafer line-by-line against Step 1's TSMC spec — immediately revealing three distinct physical failure walls.
2.how_to_use: Click 'Load 8-Wafer Preloaded Dataset' on the Recommended AMAT Producer Baseline Lot (or test the 6-wafer Dust Stress Lot / upload a CSV), then scan the red FAIL badges in the table to see why single-step tweaks hit a dead end.

deep_dives.q: What are the 3 failure walls revealed in the 8-wafer baseline lot?
deep_dives.a: (1) Legacy 13.56 MHz coupons (BL-01..04) suffer high sheath ion bombardment (~28 eV) that activates top-corner dangling bonds, pinching off 110 nm vias at 588–794 nm with 146–253 nm OB and corner cracks. (2) High pressure + low Ar (BL-02) triggers gas-phase C₂ₙH⁻ dust nodules. (3) Single-step 27.12 MHz (BL-06..08) reaches 964 nm fill at 118 nm OB, but cutting time (BL-07) starves fill to 815 nm, and adding excess NH₃ at 535 °C (BL-08) drops density to 1.74 g/cm³.

3.banner_title: Step 3 Guide: Versioned Knowledge Governance, IP Separation & Physics/Chemistry Priors
3.what_happens: Pure black-box ML needs hundreds of wafers because it starts ignorant of plasma sheaths, ballistic Knudsen transport, and chamber hardware limits. Layer 2 injects structured scientific and engineering priors into the Brain while enforcing strict IP governance across three tiers: (1) Public Peer-Reviewed Science (102 papers + 10 benchmark tables), (2) Proprietary AMAT Producer Chamber BKMs (AST-compiled rules PROP-AMAT-01..05), and (3) Customer Lot Metrology.
3.how_to_use: Try switching between KB v1.0 (Public Only), KB v2.0 (+ Chamber Hardware Guards), and KB v2.1 (Recommended Full Hybrid) to see how active rules change. Review the Chemistry & Physics incorporation cards and try the Configuration Paper Search below before continuing to Step 4A.

deep_dives.q: What actually changes inside the math when I switch KB v1.0 → KB v2.0 → KB v2.1?
deep_dives.a: KB v1.0 provides the Stage-1 CCP & DFT Bonding neural priors plus ballistic Knudsen physics, but leaves high-pressure dust and cyclic trim unguided. KB v2.0 activates proprietary hardware hazard penalties (PROP-AMAT-01..03) that zero out acquisition weight in dusty/arcing zones. KB v2.1 adds positive prior shifts and selectivity guidance for 27.12 MHz VHF + NH₃ passivation (PROP-AMAT-04) and cyclic Ar/NH₃ mouth trim (PROP-AMAT-05), cutting search waste by >60%.

deep_dives.q: How do Chemistry and Physics couple mathematically across Stages 1–4?
deep_dives.a: Gas-phase CCP physics sets electron density n_e and sheath ion energy E_i; gas/surface chemistry converts NH₃ + C₂H₂ radical ratios into volatile HCN scavenging and surface passivation coverage θ_pass(z), determining effective sticking β_eff; Knudsen ballistic transport maps β_eff into depth-resolved growth v_net(z) via Thiele modulus Φ; and Steinbrüchel ion-etch yield models cyclic Ar/NH₃ mouth shaving of top overburden.

4A.banner_title: Step 4A Guide: AI Gap Triage & Calling Coupled Multi-Scale Simulations In-Platform
4A.what_happens: Inspecting Step 2's data + Step 3's KB, the AI spots a critical blind spot: all 8 baseline wafers were single-step depositions (0% cyclic trim), so a purely data-driven model would have huge uncertainty in cyclic Dep–Etch–Dep (DED) space! Layer 3 bridges that gap before cutting cleanroom wafers by running coupled 3-scale simulations: Chamber CCP Plasma → 1D Ballistic Knudsen Feature Profile → 3D Atomistic a-C:H:N Network Relaxation.
4A.how_to_use: Click '⚡ Load Prebuilt 6-Run Multi-Scale Simulation Pack' to assimilate 6 benchmark simulations covering 13.56 vs. 27.12 MHz, 12%–24% cyclic trim, and high-NH₃ density dilution — then try tweaking the knobs on the right and clicking '▶ Run Live Multi-Scale Simulation' to execute a new coupled run on the spot!

deep_dives.q: How do the 3 simulation scales pass boundary conditions to each other?
deep_dives.a: (1) The CCP reactor model takes chamber knobs (RF, Power, Gap, P, Ar, C₂H₂, NH₃, T) and outputs ion energy E_i (eV), radical flux ratio Γ_(H+NHx)/Γ_C2Hx, and Knudsen number Kn. (2) The Feature-scale Knudsen solver uses those exact fluxes + cyclic trim fraction to integrate sidewall and bottom film evolution (PH₁₁₀, OB, keyhole void width). (3) The 3D Molecular engine (RDKit ETKDGv3 + MMFF94s, plus exportable LAMMPS ReaxFF C/H/N decks) relaxes a stoichiometric a-C:H:N cluster to predict sp²/sp³ fractions and bulk density ρ.

4B.banner_title: Step 4B Guide: Plain-English Process Synthesis & How to Read the Two Mechanism Figures
4B.what_happens: Before approving cleanroom wafers, a Principal PECVD Technologist and customer integration lead need an interpretable physical picture — not just a table of numbers. Step 4B synthesizes the calibrated kinetic parameters (θ̂), wafer residuals, and simulation pack into a clear mechanistic diagnosis plus two publication-grade visual figures.
4B.how_to_use: Read the 3 quantitative takeaways at top, then compare Panels A, B, and C in Figure 1 (left) and inspect where the red × baseline wafers, blue ◇ simulations, and green target box sit in Figure 2 (right).

deep_dives.q: How do I read Figure 1 (the 3 HAR Via Cross-Sections)?
deep_dives.a: Each column shows a 110 nm wide × 1000 nm deep SiO₂ via to scale, with the dashed amber line marking TSMC's 85 nm max planar overburden cap. In Panel A (13.56 MHz), high-energy ions create sticky upper sidewalls that bridge early and trap a large red keyhole void with 182 nm OB. In Panel B (27.12 MHz + NH₃, 0% trim), radicals bounce deep (964 nm) leaving a tiny 7.5 nm seam, but top OB (118 nm) still breaches the 85 nm line. In Panel C (+22% cyclic Ar/NH₃ trim), grazing-angle trim arrows shave the top collar and planar OB down to 63.8 nm while bottom-up growth fills 100% void-free.

deep_dives.q: How do I read Figure 2 (the 2D Operating Regime Map)?
deep_dives.a: The horizontal axis is NH₃/C₂H₂ flow ratio (controlling surface passivation vs. nitrogen incorporation) and the vertical axis is Cyclic Trim % (controlling top-mouth shaving). Left of N/C = 0.30 (pink) sticking is too high -> keyhole pinch-off. Below Trim = 14% (amber) planar overburden exceeds 85 nm. Right of N/C = 0.385 at low temperature (purple) excess -NH₂ softens density below 1.80 g/cm³. Notice all 8 baseline red × wafers sit along the bottom 0%-trim edge — completely outside the green TSMC Target Window!

5.banner_title: Step 5 Guide: Active Bayesian Optimization — Proposing the Fewest Wafers to Hit Spec
5.what_happens: Patterned 300 mm HAR test wafers and cross-section FIB-SEM slots are expensive (~$2,500–$4,000 per wafer including metrology and chamber time). Instead of a 27-wafer full-factorial DoE grid, Layer 3 evaluates thousands of candidate multi-step recipes using Constrained Expected Improvement (cEI) and selects a diverse 3-wafer cassette split with immutable UUID prediction logs.
5.how_to_use: Click '🎯 Run Bayesian Optimization' to generate the 3-wafer run-sheet. Inspect each wafer's assigned DoE role, predicted PH₁₁₀ ± σ, OB ± σ, density ρ, and P(Meets TSMC Spec), optionally export the .csv run-sheet for the chamber, then continue to Step 6.

deep_dives.q: Why does Bayesian Optimization propose 3 different roles instead of 3 nearly identical recipes?
deep_dives.a: Batch diversity (penalizing kernel correlation across the 3 slots) prevents wasting 3 wafers on the same unknown bias: Wafer #1 (Exploitation Anchor) targets the highest joint probability of passing TSMC's spec right now; Wafer #2 (High-Trim Low-OB Probe) pushes deeper into 24% cyclic trim to map the overburden floor; and Wafer #3 (Control / Boundary Guard) anchors RF sheath or thermal crosslinking sensitivity so the GP uncertainty collapses rapidly.

6.banner_title: Step 6 Guide: Cleanroom Metrology Return, Line-by-Line Grading & Prediction Audit
6.what_happens: After running the 3 proposed wafers in the Producer PECVD chamber and measuring cross-section CD-SEM, XRR density, inline OES, and AFM roughness, the results flow back into Layer 1. Every wafer is automatically graded against all 6 TSMC acceptance criteria, linked back to its pre-run UUID prediction to audit model accuracy, and assimilated to update θ̂ and GP posteriors.
6.how_to_use: Click '📥 Load & Auto-Grade Cleanroom Results (3 Wafers)' (or open the manual entry drawer to test your own numbers) and examine which spec lines turned green PASS vs. red FAIL.

deep_dives.q: Why doesn't Round 1 pass 100% immediately — and why is Round 1's 'near-miss' actually a huge win?
deep_dives.a: In real cleanroom development, jumping into a brand-new cyclic trim regime (0% -> 24% trim) often uncovers a secondary material trade-off! Round 1 solves the hardest geometric barriers immediately — TSMC-R1-W1 hits seamless 991.2 nm fill & 1.83 g/cm³ density (missing OB <= 85 nm by just 9.2 nm), while TSMC-R1-W2 hits 65.8 nm OB & 993.8 nm fill (missing ρ >= 1.80 g/cm³ by just 0.03 g/cm³ because high NH₃ at 544 °C left un-crosslinked -NH₂ groups). Bracketing both sides in 3 wafers gives the exact physical key needed to close qualification in Round 2!

7.banner_title: Step 7 Guide: Turning Round-1 Cleanroom Surprises into Versioned Institutional Knowledge (KB v2.2)
7.what_happens: When Round 1's TSMC-R1-W2 wafer comes back at ρ = 1.77 g/cm³ (< 1.80 spec), a conventional black-box optimizer only sees a scalar penalty on one data point. Here, the platform diagnoses the physical residual — aggressive NH₃ trim (>=18%) + high N/C (>0.38) below 555 °C retains terminal -NH₂ groups — and proposes an explicit, human-readable AST causal rule (PROP-TSMC-06) that upgrades your Knowledge Base from KB v2.1 to KB v2.2.
7.how_to_use: Read the Residual & Mechanism Diagnosis and the candidate AST rule expression, click '✓ Promote Rule PROP-TSMC-06 into Knowledge Base (Upgrade → KB v2.2)', then proceed to Step 8.

deep_dives.q: Why promote an explicit KB rule instead of relying purely on the Gaussian Process residual?
deep_dives.a: Two reasons: (1) Immediate global generalization — the rule steers Round 2 directly into T >= 560 °C + N/C ∈ [0.33, 0.37] across the entire recipe space instead of only within one local GP length-scale; and (2) Reusable institutional memory — when the next customer asks for a 95 nm HAR plug six months later, KB v2.2 already carries this verified Trim × Temperature crosslinking law!

8.banner_title: Step 8 Guide: Closing the Loop to 100% Spec Compliance & Cleanroom Recipe Sign-Off
8.what_happens: With KB v2.2 active and Round-1 metrology assimilated, repeating Steps 4–6 for Round 2 co-optimizes 27.12 MHz VHF plasma, N/C = 0.352 passivation, 22% cyclic Ar/NH₃ mouth trim, and 566 °C thermal de-amination. All 3 Round-2 wafers pass 100% of TSMC's criteria simultaneously — led by qualified winner TSMC-R2-W1 (PH₁₁₀ = 996.4 nm, PH₂₂₅ = 998.2 nm, OB = 63.8 nm, ρ = 1.84 g/cm³, AFM R_q = 1.18 nm, zero cracks/nodules).
8.how_to_use: If Round 2 hasn't run yet, click '⚡ Run Round 2 Loop (Steps 4–6) to Convergence Now' (or step through Round 2 manually). Once qualified, inspect the green TSMC Qualification Certificate, Trajectory Chart, export the .json sign-off package, or click '⚙ Inspect in 6-Tab Workbench' for deep diagnostics.

deep_dives.q: What is the bottom-line cleanroom ROI demonstrated by this 8-step campaign?
deep_dives.a: Qualification converged in just 2 active DoE rounds (6 optimization wafers + 8 baseline coupons = 14 patterned wafers total), compared with 8–10 manual trial-and-error rounds (45–60 wafers and 5–6 weeks of cross-team iteration) typical of dual-CD HAR gap-fill development — while leaving behind a versioned Knowledge Base (KB v2.2) and full UUID prediction-to-metrology audit trail.

har.definition: Feature depth divided by critical opening width (AR = Depth / CD). At AR >= 8:1 (e.g., 1000 nm deep / 110 nm wide = 9.1:1), reactive radicals collide dozens of times with upper sidewalls before reaching the floor.

ph_depth.definition: Depth from the top mold opening down to the shallowest void or seam inside the 110 nm tight feature or 225 nm wide feature. Seamless bottom-up plug fill requires PH >= 985 nm in a 1000 nm deep feature.

overburden.definition: Unwanted blanket carbon thickness deposited on top of the flat field between features. TSMC caps OB <= 85 nm so downstream CMP or plasma etch-back stays single-step without dishing.

keyhole_void.definition: A hollow teardrop cavity trapped inside the trench/via when upper sidewalls grow faster than the bottom and seal the throat early. Trapped voids outgas and burst during 400 °C anneal or plasma etch.

ccp.definition: Parallel-plate PECVD reactor architecture (e.g., Applied Materials Producer) where RF power across a heated showerhead-to-pedestal gap (400–500 mils) sustains the plasma.

vhf_27mhz.definition: Doubling RF frequency from 13.56 to 27.12 MHz increases electron density (n_e ~ f^2) for efficient NH₃/C₂H₂ dissociation while cutting capacitive sheath voltage V_sh and ion energy E_i (~29 eV -> ~11 eV), preventing top-corner overhang.

knudsen.definition: Ratio of gas mean free path (lambda ~ 8–14 um at 18 Torr) to feature width (CD = 110 nm). Because Kn ~ 70–130 >> 1, gas transport inside the feature is purely ballistic free-molecular bounce, not continuum fluid flow.

thiele.definition: Dimensionless competition between sidewall reaction loss and ballistic transport down the hole: Φ = AR * sqrt(1.5 * beta_eff). Seamless fill requires Φ < 0.85, which means lowering sticking probability beta_eff below ~0.008.

beta_eff.definition: Probability that a carbon growth radical sticks on a single wall collision. Unpassivated C₂H• has high β ~ 0.08 (sticks near the mouth); -H and -NH₂ surface passivation lowers β_eff below 0.007 so radicals bounce >100 times to the bottom.

hcn_scavenging.definition: Adding NH₃ supplies H• and NHₓ• radicals that cap surface dangling bonds with -H/-NH₂ and convert reactive C₂Hₓ oligomers into volatile HCN gas that pumps away harmlessly.

dust_nodule.definition: At high pressure (>20 Torr) and long gas residence time (low Ar dilution), C₂H⁻ anions polymerize in the plasma bulk into carbon nanoparticles that fall onto the wafer as killer nodule defects.

ded_trim.definition: Deposition–Etch–Deposition cycle where brief directional Ar⁺/NHₓ⁺ ion-assisted chemical etch selectively shaves the z < 120 nm top entrance collar and planar overburden without etching the shielded feature floor.

griffith_crack.definition: Elastic strain energy release rate G = sigma^2 * h_OB * (1 - nu) / E. When compressive stress sigma and planar overburden h_OB are both high (OB > 155 nm), G exceeds interfacial toughness G_c and the carbon film cracks.

film_density.definition: Bulk mass density measured by X-Ray Reflectivity. TSMC requires ρ >= 1.80 g/cm³ to guarantee pattern-transfer hardmask etch resistance in downstream CF₄/O₂ plasma.

afm_rq.definition: Root-mean-square top-surface height variation measured by inline Atomic Force Microscopy. Smooth sp²/sp³ carbon (R_q <= 1.6 nm) avoids lithography focus errors and post-CMP micro-scratches.

map_theta.definition: Maximum A Posteriori estimation of the 6 physical surface-kinetic constants (β_c0, k_pass, γ_rec, y_iece, ob_scale, crack_thresh) anchored to literature priors and updated every time cleanroom wafers arrive.

gp_discrepancy.definition: Non-parametric probabilistic model trained on the residual gap between calibrated physics and real wafer measurements, providing honest epistemic uncertainty (± σ) everywhere in recipe space.

constrained_ei.definition: Acquisition score cEI(x) = EI(x) * P(Meets All Spec Lines | x) * RulePrior(x) that balances exploiting high-probability sweet spots with exploring high-uncertainty regions that could unlock lower overburden.

reaxff.definition: Atomistic relaxation of amorphous C/H/N bonding networks (sp² rings, sp³ crosslinks, -NH₂/-C≡N terminations) predicting bulk density ρ, stress, and fluorine etch barriers before running wafers.

oes_actinometry.definition: Optical Emission Spectroscopy ratio dividing CN* radical emission (388.3 nm) by inert Ar* emission (750.4 nm) to track real-time HCN scavenging and nitrogen passivation inside the chamber without breaking vacuum.

rf_3w.definition: Ratio of 3rd-harmonic RF current to fundamental RF current at the matchbox. Non-linear sheath capacitance and trapped C₂ₙH⁻ dust clouds spike 3ω/1ω above 9.5%, providing an early warning before particle defects land.

dual_cd.definition: Real logic and memory dies place narrow vias (110 nm, AR 9.1) right next to wide trenches (225 nm, AR 4.4). A valid recipe must fill both simultaneously without voids in the narrow via or under-fill in the wide trench.

residence_time.definition: Average time gas molecules spend inside the active RF gap (τ_res ~ P * V_gap / Q_total). If τ_res exceeds ~42 ms in C₂H₂ plasma, negative C₂H⁻ ions have time to polymerize into killer dust nodules.

sp2_sp3.definition: Amorphous carbon hardmasks balance aromatic sp² rings (thermal stability), tetrahedral sp³ C-C crosslinks (mechanical stiffness & density), and C=N bridges. Terminal -NH₂/-CH₃ groups lower stress but dilute density if excessive.

etch_selectivity.definition: Carbon gap-fill plugs serve as sacrificial pattern-transfer masks during aggressive fluorocarbon oxide/nitride RIE. Dense carbon (ρ >= 1.80 g/cm³) raises the fluorine activation barrier so the mask erodes slowly.

loocv.definition: Honest small-data accuracy test: holds out 1 wafer at a time, re-runs both Bayesian MAP θ̂ calibration and GP fitting from scratch on the remaining N-1 wafers, and measures blind prediction error on the held-out wafer.

sandbox_s1.definition: Strict cleanroom data boundary: demo trials, virtual wafers, and synthetic DoE campaigns execute in an isolated sandbox brain so real measured customer wafer ledgers can never be overwritten or polluted.

chemistry_incorporation.stage: Gas-Phase Radical & Anion Chemistry (Stage 1A)
chemistry_incorporation.reaction: C₂H₂ + e⁻ → C₂H• + H•   |   C₂H⁻ + n C₂H₂ → C₂ₙH⁻ (dust)
chemistry_incorporation.mechanism: Electron-impact dissociation generates ethynyl (`C₂H•`, bare sticking `beta_0 ~ 0.08`) while acetylene anion chain polymerization forms negatively charged nanoparticles trapped in the plasma potential if residence time `tau_res` is too long.
chemistry_incorporation.model_coupling: Computes `gamma_c2hx`, `dust_margin`, and OES `C₂/CH` directly from `(freq, power, P, gap, Ar, C₂H₂)`.

chemistry_incorporation.stage: Surface Site Passivation & Volatile HCN Scavenging (Stage 1A -> Stage 2)
chemistry_incorporation.reaction: NH₃ + e⁻ → NHₓ• + H•   |   NHₓ• + C₂Hₓ(ads) → HCN(g)↑ + -C-H / -C-NH₂(surf)
chemistry_incorporation.mechanism: Ammonia radicals abstract reactive carbon oligomers into volatile `HCN` gas (tracked live via OES `CN/Ar`) and passivate sidewall dangling bonds with `-H` and `-NH₂`, slashing effective sticking `beta_eff` from `0.032` down to `0.006`.
chemistry_incorporation.model_coupling: Governs depth-dependent passivation coverage `theta_pass(z)` and calibratable kinetic constant `k_pass`.

chemistry_incorporation.stage: Bulk Amorphous Network Crosslinking & Hardmask Density (Stage 1B + 3D Molecular Sim)
chemistry_incorporation.reaction: sp² C=C + -NH₂ --(ΔT >= 560 °C, E_i)--> C=N-C bridge + H₂(g)↑
chemistry_incorporation.mechanism: At low temperature (`< 545 °C`) and excess `NH₃`, terminal `-NH₂` groups break up the carbon network (`rho < 1.78 g/cm³`). Thermal activation (`>= 560 °C`) drives de-amination into dense `sp²/sp³/C=N` crosslinks (`rho >= 1.82 g/cm³`) needed for TSMC etch selectivity.
chemistry_incorporation.model_coupling: 16-anchor DFT/XPS neural surrogate + callable RDKit `MMFF94s` / `LAMMPS ReaxFF` 3D nanocluster relaxation.

physics_incorporation.stage: Capacitive RF Sheath Electrodynamics & Fluidic Gap Physics (Stage 1A)
physics_incorporation.equation: n_e ∝ ω² P_rf ,   V_sh ∝ P_rf / (ω^α n_e) ,   ΔP_Poiseuille = 3 μ Q / (π d³)
physics_incorporation.mechanism: Switching from `13.56 MHz` to `27.12 MHz` doubles plasma frequency `ω`, raising radical dissociation while dropping ion sheath energy `E_i` from `~28 eV` to `~11 eV` so ions stop activating high-sticking dangling bonds at the feature entrance.
physics_incorporation.model_coupling: Feeds ion energy `E_i`, sheath thickness `2s_m/d`, and Poiseuille radial uniformity check.

physics_incorporation.stage: Ballistic Knudsen Transport & View-Factor Shadowing (Stage 2)
physics_incorporation.equation: Kn = λ_mfp / CD ≈ 70–130 ≫ 1 ,   Γ_C(z)/Γ_C(0) = cosh(Φ(1 - z/L)) / cosh(Φ)
physics_incorporation.mechanism: Inside a `110 nm` hole at `18 Torr`, gas molecules never collide with each other — only with sidewalls. Directional ions hit the top field (`F_view = 1.0`) while isotropic passivated neutrals bounce >100× to the bottom (`z = 1000 nm`), enabling bottom-up superconformal fill (`v_floor > v_mouth`).
physics_incorporation.model_coupling: 1D ballistic reaction-transport profile solver calibrated end-to-end via Bayesian MAP (`theta^`) on real SEM wafers.

physics_incorporation.stage: Steinbrüchel Cyclic Mouth Trim & Griffith Fracture Mechanics (Stage 2 -> Stage 4)
physics_incorporation.equation: Y_trim(E_i) = b · max(0, √E_i - √E_th) ,   G = σ² h_OB (1 - ν) / E < G_c
physics_incorporation.mechanism: Cyclic `Ar/NH₃` plasma trim shaves top planar overburden `h_OB` and re-opens the `z < 120 nm` throat, simultaneously satisfying TSMC's `OB <= 85 nm` CMP cap and keeping elastic strain energy `G` far below the oxide-interface cracking threshold `G_c`.
physics_incorporation.model_coupling: Couples calibrated physics + Matérn-5/2 GP residuals (`± σ`) into Constrained Expected Improvement BO.

understanding.headline: Baseline Diagnosis (0 Wafers, 0 Pass): Single-Step PECVD Cannot Simultaneously Beat TSMC's PH >= 985 nm Fill and OB <= 70 nm Overburden Cap
key_findings: 13.56 MHz RF fails fundamentally: high capacitive sheath energy (~28 eV) creates unpassivated dangling bonds at the z < 100 nm entrance, pinching off 110 nm holes at 588–794 nm with 146–253 nm OB.

Switching to 27.12 MHz + NH₃/C₂H₂ ≈ 0.35 lowers sticking β_eff from ~0.031 to ~0.0065 (Thiele Φ₁₁₀ ≈ 0.90), lifting single-step fill to 964 nm — still 21 nm short of 985 nm while OB = 118 nm exceeds 85 nm.

Step 4A multi-scale simulations show the unlock: adding 18–24% cyclic Ar/NH₃ mouth trim (DED) selectively shaves the top collar and planar OB down to 60–70 nm while keeping the throat open until z = 1000 nm fills seamlessly.
understanding.ai_strategy: Selected Strategy: Physics-Informed Constrained Expected Improvement (cEI) restricted to dust-free Ar >= 10.5 slm, probing 27.12 MHz + cyclic Ar/NH₃ trim [12%–24%] + NH₃/C₂H₂ [0.34–0.40] against one 13.56 MHz trimmed control.
